ATL.name: Jock Landale
ATL.detail: Landale (hip) won't play Sunday against the Pistons.

ATL.name: Asa Newell
ATL.detail: Newell underwent surgery Tuesday for a plantar plate tear in his left great toe, and he will be re-evaluated in approximately four months, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

ATL.name: CJ McCollum
ATL.detail: McCollum (calf) will miss at least four weeks, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

ATL.name: Mouhamed Gueye
ATL.detail: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

ATL.name: Henri Veesaar
ATL.detail: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

BKN.name: Nolan Traore
BKN.detail: Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

CHA.name: Grayson Allen
CHA.detail: Allen (concussion) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies.

CHA.name: Grant Williams
CHA.detail: Williams (hamstring) won't play Monday's game against the Grizzlies.

CHA.name: Kon Knueppel
CHA.detail: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

CHA.name: Dennis Schroder
CHA.detail: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

CHI.name: Norman Powell
CHI.detail: Powell has been diagnosed with a mild right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated later this week.

CHI.name: Caleb Wilson
CHI.detail: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

CLE.name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
CLE.detail: Tomlin (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.

CLE.name: Evan Mobley
CLE.detail: Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.

GS.name: Brandon Williams
GS.detail: Head coach Steve Kerr said Monday that Williams (hamstring) is on track to return Wednesday against the Kings, Kenzo Fukuda of ClutchPoints.com reports.

GS.name: Stephen Curry
GS.detail: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

GS.name: Kristaps Porzingis
GS.detail: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

GS.name: Moses Moody
GS.detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

GS.name: Jimmy Butler III
GS.detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

IND.name: T.J. McConnell
IND.detail: McConnell is out for Monday's game against the Thunder due to left hamstring soreness.

IND.name: Aaron Nesmith
IND.detail: Nesmith is out for Monday's game against the Thunder due to right foot soreness.

IND.name: Tyrese Haliburton
IND.detail: Haliburton (hamstring) is expected to miss at least two more weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

IND.name: Johnny Furphy
IND.detail: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

IND.name: Ben Sheppard
IND.detail: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

MEM.name: Cameron Boozer
MEM.detail: Boozer (ankle) will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

MEM.name: Jerami Grant
MEM.detail: Grant was diagnosed with a grade 1 left calf strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.

MEM.name: GG Jackson
MEM.detail: Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.

MEM.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
MEM.detail: Pippen (back) is progressing in his recovery but is still considered week-to-week.

MEM.name: Richie Saunders
MEM.detail: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

MIA.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
MIA.detail: Antetokounmpo (groin) won't play in Sunday's game against Oklahoma City, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

MIN.name: Jaylen Clark
MIN.detail: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

MIN.name: Anthony Edwards
MIN.detail: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

MIN.name: Donte DiVincenzo
MIN.detail: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

NO.name: Trendon Watford
NO.detail: Watford (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Spurs.

NO.name: Bennedict Mathurin
NO.detail: Mathurin (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.

NO.name: Dejounte Murray
NO.detail: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

NY.name: Miles McBride
NY.detail: McBride (abdomen) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Pacers.

NY.name: OG Anunoby
NY.detail: Anunoby (calf) won't play Sunday against the Pacers.

NY.name: Jordan Clarkson
NY.detail: Clarkson (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.

OKC.name: Jaylin Williams
OKC.detail: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers

OKC.name: Nikola Topic
OKC.detail: Topic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.

OKC.name: Aday Mara
OKC.detail: Mara (shin) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers.

OKC.name: Jalen Williams
OKC.detail: Williams (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.

OKC.name: Alex Caruso
OKC.detail: Caruso (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.

OKC.name: Thomas Sorber
OKC.detail: Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.

OKC.name: Cason Wallace
OKC.detail: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

OKC.name: Chet Holmgren
OKC.detail: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

PHI.name: Joel Embiid
PHI.detail: Embiid (illness) is out for Monday's game against Portland, Austin Krell of OnPattison.com reports.

PHI.name: Ariel Hukporti
PHI.detail: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

PHX.name: Mark Williams
PHX.detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

POR.name: Chris Youngblood
POR.detail: Youngblood (heel) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Knicks.

POR.name: Vit Krejci
POR.detail: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

POR.name: Ja Morant
POR.detail: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

POR.name: Shaedon Sharpe
POR.detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

TOR.name: Nate Bittle
TOR.detail: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bucks, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

TOR.name: Kawhi Leonard
TOR.detail: Leonard (knee) could return in the next few weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

TOR.name: RJ Barrett
TOR.detail: Barrett has been diagnosed with a right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
